# vue-multiple-themes

> Vue 3 multi-theme engine with CSS custom properties, TailwindCSS opacity modifiers, WCAG contrast tools, and white-label brand contexts.

## Overview

vue-multiple-themes is a zero-dependency Vue 3 package that provides:
- Multiple theme support (7 presets + unlimited custom themes)
- TailwindCSS v3 & v4 plugins with full opacity modifier support (bg-vmt-primary/50)
- WCAG 2.1 contrast and accessibility utilities
- White-label / multi-tenant theme isolation via createBrandContext()
- Dynamic theme generation from a single brand color
- 20+ tree-shakeable color utility functions
- localStorage/sessionStorage persistence with OS preference detection
- SSR-safe design (all DOM access guarded)

## Installation

```
pnpm add vue-multiple-themes
npm install vue-multiple-themes
yarn add vue-multiple-themes
```

## Quick Start

```ts
import { createApp } from 'vue'
import { VueMultipleThemesPlugin, PRESET_THEMES } from 'vue-multiple-themes'

const app = createApp(App)
app.use(VueMultipleThemesPlugin, {
  themes: PRESET_THEMES,
  defaultTheme: 'light',
  strategy: 'both',
})
app.mount('#app')
```

```vue
<script setup>
import { useTheme, PRESET_THEMES } from 'vue-multiple-themes'
const { current, isDark, setTheme, toggleTheme } = useTheme({ themes: PRESET_THEMES })
</script>
```

## Core API

### useTheme(options): UseThemeReturn

Reactive composable. Returns: current (theme name), isDark (boolean), theme (definition), resolvedColors (RGB objects), setTheme(name), nextTheme(), prevTheme(), toggleTheme().

Options: themes (required), defaultTheme, strategy ('attribute'|'class'|'both'), storage ('localStorage'|'sessionStorage'|'none'), storageKey, cssVarPrefix, respectSystemPreference, namespace, onChange, onThemeChange.

### createBrandContext(options): BrandContext

Factory for isolated namespaced theme engines. Each context gets its own CSS variables, storage, and reactive state. Requires namespace option.

Returns: namespace (string), useTheme(overrides?), BrandPlugin (Vue plugin).

### VueMultipleThemesPlugin

Vue 3 plugin. Registers <VueMultipleThemes> globally, injects CSS vars, applies initial theme.

## Color Utilities

All functions accept hex strings and are SSR-safe:

- hexToRgb(hex) → [r, g, b]
- rgbToHex(r, g, b) → hex
- hexToHsl(hex) → [h, s, l]
- hslToHex(h, s, l) → hex
- parseColor(cssColor) → [h, s, l]
- lighten(hex, amount) → hex
- darken(hex, amount) → hex
- saturate(hex, amount) → hex
- rotateHue(hex, degrees) → hex
- mix(hexA, hexB, weight) → hex
- withAlpha(hex, alpha) → rgba string
- luminance(hex) → number (WCAG 2.1)
- contrastRatio(hexA, hexB) → number (≥4.5=AA, ≥7=AAA)
- autoContrast(bg) → white or black hex
- ensureContrast(text, bg, minRatio) → adjusted hex
- generateColorScale(hex) → { 50..950 }
- complementary(hex) → hex
- triadic(hex) → [hex, hex, hex]
- analogous(hex, angle) → [hex, hex, hex]
- normalizeToRgbChannels(color) → "R G B"

## Theme Generators

- generateLightTheme(hex, options?) → ThemeDefinition (WCAG AA compliant)
- generateDarkTheme(hex, options?) → ThemeDefinition
- generateThemePair(hex, options?) → [light, dark]
- generateThemeFromPalette(palette, variant, options?) → ThemeDefinition
- generateSeasonalThemes(season) → [light, dark] (spring|summer|autumn|winter|midnight|neon|pastel)
- checkContrast(fg, bg) → { ratio, aa, aaLarge, aaa, aaaLarge }

## TailwindCSS

```js
// tailwind.config.js (v3)
const vmtPlugin = require('vue-multiple-themes/tailwind')
module.exports = { plugins: [vmtPlugin({ themes, cssVarPrefix: '--vmt-' })] }

// v4
import vmtPlugin from 'vue-multiple-themes/tailwind-v4'
```

Classes: bg-vmt-primary, text-vmt-text, border-vmt-border, with opacity: bg-vmt-primary/50

## Components

- <VueMultipleThemes> — wrapper with slot props
- <VmtThemePicker> — headless picker with keyboard nav & ARIA
- <VmtIcon :as="Component"> — icon forwarder (bring your own library)
